question: With reference to the travellers who visited India, who among the following was from Portugal?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Duarte Barbosa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Duarte Barbosa** was a Portuguese traveler and writer.
 
• He visited India during the early part of the **16th century** and was one of the first Europeans to provide a detailed description of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• Barbosa served as a **scribe and interpreter** for the Portuguese colonial administration in India.
